records.title: fix(architecture): keep verification digest serialization out of domain
records.release_claim: verification-result domain validation depends on a neutral canonical digest adapter rather than output-layer or domain-layer serialization drift
records.reason: The landed execution-result contract is only stable if command-digest serialization has one implementation outside domain and output projections; moved-result coverage and traceability were updated with the boundary.
records.non_claim: The refactor does not execute a command or strengthen a caller-authored result.
